subject: [PATCH 11/60] fork: check cached stack locality only on common memory nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author posted the same message twice, likely due to a relay issue. The patch modifies try_release_thread_stack_to_cache() to skip checking stack locality when the local node has no common memory.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the try_release_thread_stack_to_cache() function to skip checking stack locality when the local node has no common memory. This change allows CPUs on nodes outside N_MEMORY_COMMON to cache stacks from other nodes, improving performance.
